- [USER] User expressed interest in the influence of ancient architecture on modern design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The architecture of ancient civilizations such as Greece and Rome has greatly influenced modern-day design in numerous ways.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Influence includes: 
  1. [FACT] Columns and Pediments: Use of Doric, Ionic, and Corinthian columns of ancient Greece and Tuscan, Doric, and Composite columns of Rome.
  2. [FACT] Symmetry: Precise symmetry in ancient architecture is a fundamental aspect of contemporary design.
  3. [FACT] Arches and Vaults: Ancient Romans introduced arches and vaults in construction.
  4. [FACT] Material Usage: Ancient Greek architecture used marble, limestone, and granite; Roman architecture used bricks, mortar, and concrete.
  5. [FACT] Civic and Public Buildings: Ancient Greeks and Romans created monumental civic and public buildings influencing modern government buildings and monuments.
  6. [FACT] Landscape Design: Integration of architecture with beautiful surroundings influenced modern garden and landscaping design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Conclusion: Ancient architecture serves as a rich source of inspiration and continues to impact modern-day design.

  3. [FACT] The Sydney Opera House in Sydney, Australia - Sail-like appearance reminiscent of ancient Greek and Roman amphitheaters.
